# JS Central
> Personal portfolio and engineering journal by JS, focused on embedded systems, firmware, frontend engineering, and practical security research.

## About
JS Central documents projects that connect physical hardware, software, servers, and accessible web interfaces. The site is maintained by JS.

## Core topics
- Embedded systems and physical computing
- Raspberry Pi, Arduino, and ESP32 projects
- Firmware development and debugging
- HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frontend engineering
- Accessible web interfaces
- Application and systems security fundamentals
- Browser experiments and interactive prototypes

## Public pages
- Homepage: https://jscentral.org/
- Lab: https://jscentral.org/lab.html
- Journal: https://jscentral.org/journal.html
- Seasonal page: https://jscentral.org/seasonal.html
- Legal and privacy policy: https://jscentral.org/legal.html

## Content notes
Technical examples are educational and may require testing or adaptation. Security content is intended for authorized systems only. Advertising and Cloudflare delivery/statistics disclosures are available on the legal page.
